name: @vinkugor/nacos-mcp

tools.name: publish_config
tools.description:
创建新配置到 Nacos。
Create a NEW configuration in Nacos.

IMPORTANT: This tool will FAIL if the dataId already exists. To modify an existing config, use update_config instead.

configType must be one of: yaml, json, properties, toml, text.
The dataId filename extension should match the configType (e.g., mysql.yaml → yaml, db.properties → properties).

Set dryRun=true to preview the content that would be published without actually writing — always recommended before the final publish.

configType.description:
配置类型，必须是以下之一：yaml, json, properties, toml, text。
Config type, must be one of: yaml, json, properties, toml, text.

content.description:
配置内容文本。
Full configuration content as text.

dataId.description:
新配置的唯一标识符，不能与已有 dataId 重复。
Unique ID for the new config. Must not already exist in the target group.

dryRun.description:
设为 true 时只预览将要发布的 payload，不实际写入。建议发布前先用此模式确认。
Set true to preview without writing. Always recommended before final publish.

group.description:
配置所属分组。
Target group for the new config.

tools.name: update_config
tools.description:
修改 Nacos 中已存在的配置。
Modify an EXISTING configuration in Nacos.

IMPORTANT: This tool will FAIL if the dataId does not already exist. To create a new config, use publish_config instead.

configType must be one of: yaml, json, properties, toml, text.
The dataId filename extension should match the configType (e.g., mysql.yaml → yaml).

Set dryRun=true to see a side-by-side comparison (current content vs new content) without writing — always recommended before the final apply.

configType.description:
配置类型，必须是以下之一：yaml, json, properties, toml, text。
Config type, must be one of: yaml, json, properties, toml, text.

content.description:
新的配置内容，将完整替换旧内容。
New content that will fully replace the existing config.

dataId.description:
要修改的配置标识符，必须已存在于目标 group 中。
Data ID of the config to modify. Must already exist in the target group.

dryRun.description:
设为 true 时获取当前内容并与新内容对比展示，不实际写入。建议修改前先用此模式确认变更。
Set true to preview old-vs-new diff without writing. Always recommended before final apply.

group.description:
配置所属分组。
Group of the config to modify.

tools.name: get_config
tools.description:
读取 Nacos 配置中心中一条指定配置的完整内容。
Read a single Nacos configuration by its dataId and group.

Use this tool when you know the exact dataId and need the full config content.
If you don't know the dataId, first use search_config (fuzzy match) or list_configs (browse by group).

The returned content is the raw config text — parse it as YAML, JSON, Properties, TOML, or plain text depending on the config's type.

dataId.description:
配置唯一标识符。通常以文件扩展名暗示内容类型，如 application.yaml、datasource.json、nacos.properties。
Configuration data ID. Naming convention: the file extension indicates the config type (e.g., application.yaml, db.properties, config.json).

group.description:
配置所属分组，用于隔离不同环境/应用。
Configuration group used to isolate configs by environment or application.

tools.name: list_configs
tools.description:
列出指定 group 下所有配置的 dataId（不含配置内容）。
List all configuration dataIds in a group — returns names only, not the content.

Use this tool when you need to browse or discover what configurations exist in a group.
Supports pagination via pageNo/pageSize (default page 1, 100 items per page).

Tip: after you find the dataId you need, call get_config to read its actual content.
If you are looking for a specific keyword, prefer search_config which does fuzzy matching across groups.

group.description:
配置分组名称。
Target configuration group to browse.

pageNo.description:
页码，从 1 开始。
Page number, starts at 1.

pageSize.description:
每页返回条数。
Items per page.

tools.name: search_config
tools.description:
按关键字模糊搜索 dataId，返回匹配的配置列表（不含内容）。
Fuzzy-search configuration dataIds by keyword — returns matching names, not the content.

Use this tool when you don't know the exact dataId and need to find it by a partial keyword (e.g. 'mysql', 'redis').
The search does prefix matching on dataId fields.
Optionally narrow by group to limit results to a specific group.

Tip: after finding matching configs, use get_config with the returned dataId to read the full content.
If you need to see ALL configs in a group (not keyword-filtered), use list_configs instead.

group.description:
可选，限定搜索的分组。不填则跨所有分组搜索。
Optional group filter. Leave empty to search across all groups.

search.description:
搜索关键字，对 dataId 做前缀匹配。
Search keyword for prefix-matching against dataId (e.g., 'mysql', 'redis', 'application').
